title: Etale lifts descend along extensions of a separably closed field
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be an etale morphism of schemes in one universe [def-weil-pbc-etale-morphism]. Let $L$ be a separably closed field and $\Omega$ any field in the same universe, and let $\beta:L\to\Omega$ be a field homomorphism [def-pc-field-extension]. Given $t:\operatorname{Spec}L\to S$ and $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with $f\circ x=t\circ\operatorname{Spec}\beta$, there is $y:\operatorname{Spec}L\to X$ with $y\circ\operatorname{Spec}\beta=x$ and $f\circ y=t$.

proof.text: Apply the existing proved declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.exists_SpecMap_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed f beta t x to the stated compatibility. Its two conclusion equations are exactly the required factorization and base equation. The source proof factors x through its residue field, uses separability of the etale residue extension, and RingHom.exists_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed to factor that embedding through L.

lemma Scheme.Hom.exists_SpecMap_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed (f : X ⟶ S) [Etale f] {L Ω : Type u}
    [Field L] [IsSepClosed L] [Field Ω] (β : CommRingCat.of L ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω)
    (τ : Spec (.of L) ⟶ S) (g : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (hg : g ≫ f = Spec.map β ≫ τ) :
    ∃ g' : Spec (.of L) ⟶ X, Spec.map β ≫ g' = g ∧ g' ≫ f = τ
